key_finding: Most reliable imagery identity structure (43-75%) lies OUTSIDE the vision identity span (SRM truncation adds a further +0.15..+0.29 loss inside it); the within-subject O1 operator advantage lives more in that out-of-span component (G_O1_perp > G_O1_parallel). The residual is reliable but its native orientation is not identifiable from vision-only calibration, so imagery-zero-shot subject transfer is structurally blocked under the current vision-only contract.
